source_en:
Welcome to the Summer Build for Crimson Moon, which represents the current state of Crimson Moon’s progress towards First Playable later this year.

This mid-year preview represents our working version of an initial District (one of three level sections that make up our larger Ward levels) for you to explore and provide feedback on. The session concludes at the end of the District, but feel free to continue exploring the next District to get a sneak peak of where the level will continue expanding.

Please note that difficulty is reduced to allow for streamlined hands-on experience
